acip: BLA MA'I SPYI BO'I AOm LAS BDUD RTZI DKAR PO'I RGYUN BABS RANG GI SPYI BOR THIM, BUM PA'I DBANG THOB, LUS KYI SGRIB PA DAG ,LAM BSKYED RIM BSGOM PA LA DBANG, 'BRAS BU SPRUL SKU 'GRUB PA'I NUS PA BZHAG
wylie: bla ma'i spyi bo'i aoM las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun babs rang gi spyi bor thim, bum pa'i dbang thob, lus kyi sgrib pa dag ,lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang, 'bras bu sprul sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag
english: From the letter om at the tips of the Lamas' heads comes forth a stream of white nectar.  It dissolves into the tip of your own head.  You receive the empowerment of the vase, and you are purified of all your physical obstacles.  You are empowered to practice the path of the stage of creation, and the ability to achieve one of your goals--the Emanation Body--is planted within you.
